material.description: Lane commit e48d40b8 added 'scripts/gamesparks-bootstrap.mjs' to scenarios/moba/manifest.json data[] while actually placing the file at repo-root scripts/. Two defects: (1) mapexport resolves data entries relative to the scenario dir, so a data entry that is not an .osd under scenarios/moba is wrong twice -- here it points at a nonexistent relative path (CI 40532126364 'Export the maps': reading ../scenarios/moba/scripts/gamesparks-bootstrap.mjs: No such file or directory), and if moved there it would be fed to the Starlark data evaluator like the earlier .lua regression; (2) the file hard-codes an absolute machine path /workspace/oscraft/scripts/gamesparks-collection.json (violates the scripts-take-root-from-import.meta.url rule). Same symptom class as row pages-mapexport-fails-parsing-mod-lua-files-listed-as-data-in-mo; manifest data[] must hold only scenario-relative OSDT data files.
